notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE - Available Now for Free!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/6428763e3d9b4152c6bdb8e5f529f05ea666cc4e.png[/img]

We've just released a major update for Chess Knights: High Noon! 

It is a completely new story, with new characters, new mechanics and scenarios.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/932e59cd1eab95ac91260397e1dee183f72ffe74.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37117656/d3d9964dc4753b2e017364f776b6cbefa51aa140.png[/img]

Together with this content update, we've also fixed several minor issues, added a help guide and other features to make the experience great for you.

You can update your game and start playing it right away. 

And if you still does not own a copy of Chess Knights: High Noon, you can get it for only $1.99:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486800/Chess_Knights_High_Noon/

notes.title: Can you play chess blindfolded? (another NEW game released!)
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thanks a lot for all the support you've given to the Zen Chess Series. Today, we are releasing a new game in the series.

For decades, professional chess players have been mesmerizing the world with their ability of playing chess blindfolded. In Zen Chess: Blindfold Masters you will be able to experience being one of them, by solving chess puzzles without seeing the pieces.

[list]
[*] Simple to play: memorize the board presented to you in each level, hit 'play' to make the pieces invisible, and make your moves in the board;
[*] Enjoy a minimalist, beautifully designed chess board and pieces;
[*] Solve 150 chess puzzles, varying from Mate-in-One to Mate in-Four problems;
[*] Simulate the incredible experience of playing chess blindfolded in a minimalist and meditative game experience.
[/list]

Can you memorize each board and find the moves that solve the puzzle when the pieces are no longer visible?

Give it a try and show yourself your abilities go well beyond you have imagined.

You can try it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108550/Zen_Chess_Blindfold_Masters/

notes.title: Can you play like a Champion? (NEW game released!)
notes.content:
Hi all!

Thanks a lot for all the support you've given to the Zen Chess Series. Today, we are releasing a new game in the series.

And this one is quite special and different from the last ones.

In Zen Chess: Champion's Moves you will be put in the position of a World Chess Champion. Play through historical games and solve the same chess problems the champions had to solve to win each game.
[list]
[*] Solve 150 chess puzzles, from historical games played by World Chess Champions;
[*] Chess puzzles goes from Mate-in-1 to Mate in-7 problems;
[*] For chess enthusiasts looking for perfect their game while enjoying a minimalist, beautifully designed chess board and pieces;
[/list]

Can you play like a champion?

You can try it out here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1108540/Zen_Chess_Champions_Moves/

Have fun!

notes.title: Steam Achievements now available!
notes.content:
Howdy!

This sweet little game is almost 1 year old! And I have a few surprises for you...

The first surprise is that I just added Steam Achievements to this game. The names chosen for the achievements are nicknames of famous chess players (can you guess all of them?).

The second surprise is that we're working on sequels to this game. More specifically, you'll see in the next 2 months the following games on STEAM:

- Zen Chess: Mate in Two
- Zen Chess: Mate in Three
- Zen Chess: Mate in Four

This is my way to thank you for such a wonderful support you've given to this little game.

I am certain that you'll have a LOT of fun with the new games in the Zen Chess Series, so stay tuned!

Cheers!
